# WLOX

> WLOX is a local news and weather source covering Mississippi's Gulf Coast region with coverage of aviation, maritime, weather forecasts, and regional politics.

WLOX provides real-time weather forecasts, local news coverage including aerospace and maritime industries centered around Pascagoula and Ingalls Shipbuilding, and regional reporting on issues affecting Mississippi. The station covers everything from daily weather updates to major transportation disruptions and military vessel launches.

- [Airlines cancel some flights after reduced 5G rollout in US](https://www.wlox.com/2022/01/19/airlines-worldwide-rush-change-flights-over-us-5g-problem/): Airlines cancel flights due to 5G interference concerns with Boeing 777
- [Southwest limits canceled flights after 3 tumultuous days](https://www.wlox.com/2021/10/12/southwest-limits-canceled-flights-after-3-tumultuous-days/): Southwest Airlines cancellations after Florida weather disrupts nationwide flights
